name: f3-yeti-man
description: Slack HTTP starter for F3 Yeti Man

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: biome check src scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json manifest.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json manifest.json biome.json
